morning.caption:
Brent crude rose to $97.31 a barrel on Friday after Iran's IRGC said two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia said a strike suspended some operations at its Jazan refinery on November 26. OPEC+ meets Sunday.

A Nepali worker was killed at Jazan, Arab News reports. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
Altria said on November 26 it is considering a possible all cash offer for Britain's Imperial Brands, which said it has received no approach. Imperial shares rose 13.3% and Japan Tobacco rose 4.5% on a report it may join. Altria must bid or walk away by December 24.

evening.caption:
EU leaders agreed to nominate Pablo Hernández de Cos, former governor of the Bank of Spain, as the next ECB president, succeeding Christine Lagarde, who steps down February 7, 2027. Formal appointment is due at the December European Council.

Watch Asia and Europe opens and OPEC+ on Sunday. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com
